title: Ann Connor — the 201st anniversary: Bethel needlepoint and the Miller homestead
subtitle: Bethel Presbyterian Church, Historical Room — a Sunday-school talk with a needlepoint demonstration, 6 November 1977
date_source: The tape dates itself in its first sentence: 'Today is November the 6th, 1977. We mark this as the 201st birthday of Bethel and Lebanon churches.' 1776 + 201 = 1977, so the reading is internally consistent. No copyist's slate is present; the spoken date is the evidence, and the folder name follows it.

provenance.collection: Bethel Presbyterian Church — Historical Room oral histories
provenance.capture_notes: One capture, ALAC 48 kHz stereo 16-bit, 2,675.797 s, 78,391,869 bytes, md5 283850bb88ac5c5723f5ea7da5091e9c (computed here; the source notes give no md5 to compare against). The source notes record the file as added 2026-10-18 16:48 and the NAS mtime agrees (2026-10-18 16:48 EDT). The filed document's own header reads 'digitised 2026-10-19', which the notes elsewhere treat as the transcription date; the two dates are not reconciled in the source, and 2026-10-18 is used here because it is the file's own timestamp. Master untouched; the 41 m 17 s MP3 beside it is a listening copy with the silent tail removed, not the master.

speakers.label: ANN
speakers.name: Ann Connor
speakers.note: The speaker throughout. The tape never states her name; 'Ann Connor' is family/archive attribution (the Oliver Miller Homestead Associates' published history names her as Anna (Thomas) Connor), and the content agrees — she describes her husband John, her years as a history teacher and the homestead's volunteer group.

speakers.label: INTERVIEWER
speakers.name: visiting adults (unnamed)
speakers.note: The lace and needlepoint questions from 31:00 on, and one or two earlier asides. No diarization was run; the label marks an adult voice that is not Ann's.

speakers.label: CHILD
speakers.name: children in the Sunday-school class (unnamed)
speakers.note: Short answers in the question-and-answer passages (e.g. 'What is a sample?', 'Fort Couch Road'). Inferred from content; not individually identified.
